Name: Alternative Sit Posture
Author: keithwew
Description:
I created this mod just for myself because the new sitting animation/posture to female characters in Stardew Valley new 1.5 sit feature looks weird for me when they are sitting front of you.
But i have decided to share this little quick fix mod that i created.
I don't know if i will update or maintain this but feel free to use this mod as a temporary alternative sit animation/posture mod and wait for even much more better alternative sitting animation mod like this.

Requires :
[list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]SMAPI 3.8.0

[/list]
Update 12/24/2020 : Created a alternative sit posture for male character (on version 1.1).

Installation Guide:
[list]
[*]Just Copy or extract the "[CP] Alternative Sit Posture" folder to your Mod folder and you're good to go.
[/list]
